## Summary

Describe the product change and its operator impact.

## Ownership Boundary

State which repository owns the changed behavior and which authorities remain
external.

## Public Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, operator-local paths, or real
      operator data are included.
- [ ] No dependency trees, build output, logs, or disposable runtime state are
      included.

## Security Triggers

Describe any identity, secrets, external data, backend mutation, AI action,
runtime control, deployment, or release impact. Write `None` when no trigger
applies.

## Validation

List the exact commands and results.

## Graduation Impact

State whether this change moves, validates, or changes the approved Prototype
Studio baseline.
